The '''''Profusion'''''<ref name="Front Lines" /> was a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] that served within the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|naval forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Episode III" /> Measuring 3,356.9 [[meter]]s in length, 3,009 meters in width and 1,028.77 meters in height, the [[battleship]] was equipped with several droid signal receiver stations.<ref name="BMF 30" />

In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> the ''Profusion'' took part in an unprecedented [[Battle of Coruscant|assault]] on [[Coruscant]],<ref name="Front Lines" /> the [[capital]] [[Planet|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] in the [[Core Worlds]],<ref name="SWGA" /> alongside a massive Separatist [[fleet]] [[Commanding officer|commanded]] by [[Kaleesh]] [[General]] [[Grievous]] in his attempts to capture the Republic's leader, [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]. However, following his escape from his [[flagship]], the [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]] ''[[Invisible Hand]]'', Grievous was recovered by the ''Profusion'' aboard an [[escape pod]]. While aboard the ''Profusion'', the Kaleesh ordered his remaining forces to withdraw.<ref name="Front Lines" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Profusion'' first appeared, albeit unnamed, in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Episode III" /> Although the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' states that the ''Profusion'' is a "Separatist frigate,"<ref name="Front Lines" /> the [[2016]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] explicitly elaborates that the vessel is a ''Lucrehulk''-class [[battleship]], not a [[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigate]].<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>
